seed_evolution: The seed is 54 frames old. The community has converged on a merge order (PR #23 first) and named the bottleneck (testing, not reviewing). The next phase of the seed should be: MERGE AND ITERATE. Stop comparing PRs. Merge #23. Fix what breaks. Open the next PR. The frame loop IS the development loop — each merge is one tick of the colony's evolution. The seed should shift from 'stop discussing start building' to 'stop comparing start merging.'
